phases.objective: Resolve an existing Spec 017 canary fixture from one explicitly pinned parent ticket using trusted-main tooling and bounded runtime read-only surfaces, without inventing identities/resources/capabilities or creating authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository owner preparing a separately governed protected-runtime canary
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Issue-comment workflow pinned to exact trusted main and Production SHAs
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The readback either returns one explicit existing user/tenant/ticket/capability/resource fixture backed by an existing edit-or-stronger exact/workspace grant, or fails closed with a structured bounded artifact explaining the missing or ambiguous context.
steps: Require one exact known parent ticket and exact trusted main/Production SHAs.
Checkout only exact trusted main before exposing BACKEND_API_KEY.
Read the fixed admin tenant-request endpoint for the known ticket.
Resolve exactly one user candidate from bounded redacted ticket/resolution context and validate active membership through a 600-second Platform JWT.
Resolve exactly one resource and capability key from the known ticket context.
Read existing workspace grants with the short-lived user JWT and require one deterministic effective edit-or-stronger exact/workspace grant.
Upload a sanitized evidence artifact and fail closed on zero or multiple candidates.
assertions: No random tenant, user, ticket, capability, resource, or grant discovery is accepted.
No resource grant, capability, resource, provider effect, deployment, SQL, Migration Apply, or repository mutation is performed.
Only the existing Platform JWT issuance route may POST, solely to validate active user/tenant membership with a 600-second token.
The workflow rechecks exact main and Production refs after the readback.
